gear.rpgclasses.set.barbarian_dragon.des: Dragon's Roar: Berserker Rage lets out a roar; non-boss mobs within 8 blocks flee and suffer the scales' element.
gear.rpgclasses.set.barbarian_dragonstee: Wyrm's Wrath: below 40% health or during Berserker Rage you sprout spectral wings and each critical hit releases a 4-block elemental cone (once per second).
gear.rpgclasses.set.barbarian_gold.desc: Golden Loot: when you kill a hostile mob, 10% chance it drops a gold nugget that leaps toward you.
gear.rpgclasses.set.barbarian_gold.name: Plunderer's Finery
gear.rpgclasses.set.barbarian_iron.name: Iron Harness
gear.rpgclasses.set.barbarian_leather.de: Scent: hostile mobs within 12 blocks with less than 30% health glow.
Ember Heart: each hit you take builds an ember (max 5, 8 s). Charge or Berserker Rage releases them in a 4-block ring of fire.
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_chain.desc: Ringing Links: each charge chimes and, on reaching the threshold, the links ring in chord.
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_chain.name: Ringed Gi
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_diamond.desc: Crystal Reflection: Projectile Deflection grants +1 charge with a prismatic flash.
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_diamond.name: Crystal Habit
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_dragon.desc: Dragon Dance: when you trigger a stance effect, a spectral dragon in the stance's color circles you for 4 s and bites the nearest enemy every second.
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_dragon.name: Scaled Mantle
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_dragonsteel.des: Wyrm Fist: each stance effect launches an energy dragon head that travels 8 blocks in a line. Fire: walking on lava in Fire Stance grants speed. Ice: in Water you freeze water as you walk. Lightning: in Stone, heavy hits you take release a spark.
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_gold.name: Pilgrim's Tunic
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_iron.desc: Firm Stance: Stone gains charge from hits as low as 1.5 HP.
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_iron.name: Iron Gi
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_leather.desc: First Step: when entering a stance with no charges you receive 1, and charges decay 10% slower.
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_leather.name: Novice's Wraps
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_netherite.desc: Stance Seal: Stone charges decay half as fast and, when switching stance with 5 or more charges, you leave a runic seal that repeats the discharge at 30% after 3 s.
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_netherite.name: Obsidian Kesa
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.bo.desc: Slow, with extra reach and an arc sweep that hits other enemies for 60%.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.bo.late1: Ashen Sweep: the sweep blinds mobs for 1 s.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.bo.late2: Pole Vault: crouch + jump launches you forward and you land with a shockwave (8 s).
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.bo.late3: Horizon Wave: if you wait 1.5 s between hits, the hit sends out an elemental wave in an arc.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.element.lightning: Lightning: each hit jumps to a nearby enemy.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.knuckles.desc: Worn in the Curios hands slot (or in the off hand), they improve empty-handed strikes.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.knuckles.late1: Obsidian Fists: on the 5th hit against the same target, a 2-block burst.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.knuckles.late2: Dragon Claws: your hits can inflict Wound (−30% healing for 4 s).
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.knuckles.late3: Wyrm Fists: your hits apply the element and the Monk's stance effects are 20% stronger.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.monk: Monk: counts as unarmed (charges, perks and subclass).
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.nunchaku.desc: Fast, with short reach. For the Monk it counts as unarmed.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.nunchaku.late1: Whirl: every 8 chained hits, a spin that strikes all around for 50%.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.nunchaku.late2: Bone Echo: the Whirl leaves a ghost nunchaku that repeats 3 hits at 30%.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.nunchaku.late3: Chain Storm: the Whirl becomes a 3 s whirlwind that pulls enemies in and applies the element.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.sai.desc: Medium speed. Hold right click to guard: a hit in the first instants is parried and stuns the attacker; otherwise it reduces damage.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.sai.late1: Iron Parry: the parry returns 50% of the hit.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.sai.late2: Disarm: the parry gives the attacker Weakness II for 3 s.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.sai.late3: Wyrm Counter: after a parry, your next hit within 1.5 s is an elemental thrust that pierces in a line.
